data.explanation: This is a coworking invoice for next month's desk membership and a meeting room. You need to pay €297.50 by the deadline shown, which the app calculates from the invoice date. If you pay late, the provider says your access card may be paused. If you use this space for work, keep the invoice as it may be deductible as a business expense. The note about the phone line being unavailable on 10 December 2026 is just a heads-up — written enquiries will still be handled, quoting the reference BD-1217-686.
data.tax_note: A coworking desk and meeting room invoice can typically be claimed as a work-related business expense (Betriebsausgabe/Werbungskosten) if used for professional purposes — keep this invoice for your tax records.
